insight.title: The Retailer Who Created a Pricier Appliance to Double Sales
insight.subtitle: How adding a luxury option changed how customers calculated value.
insight.notificationHook: He doubled sales by launching a pricier model

sections.text: Williams-Sonoma introduced a revolutionary $275 home breadmaker. Customers loved the idea, but the machine sat on shelves. Nobody bought it because they had no point of comparison.
Instead of discounting the product, the marketing team did something counterintuitive. They launched a second, slightly larger breadmaker and priced it at a staggering $429.
Sales of the original $275 machine instantly skyrocketed. Customers didn't buy the expensive one, but they now viewed the original as an absolute bargain they couldn't pass up.
We do not buy the product; we buy the comparison.
